answer: Voting rights vest only after a bond of 25 times the epoch's median invoice survives a 72-hour public challenge. An established non-kin peer may contest if the claimant's 2-hop funding graph collapses into a controller already on the roll, as streams vanish into one karst conduit. A valid contest takes half the bond; a false one pays a nectar bounty of 3 invoices from the challenger's stake. If no valid contest, admission is recorded and the bond unlocks over 7 days into a visible ocean of released collateral. Auditors recompute overlap, amounts, and timestamps from the public settlement log.
